item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.6

  • Checklists in notes: type [] to start one, or press the button beside the colours. Enter makes the next item, and Enter on an empty one ends the list. Click a box to tick it, and the deck's card previews show the boxes too
  • Keep the deck open: the notes stand at the edge all the time instead of resting as the dots (Settings › General)
  • Cards can open on a click instead of on hover, if you would rather the deck only fanned out when you point at it (Settings › General › Fan notes)
  • ⌘W closes the note you are in
  • A grip beside the pin drags a note around the screen, and a note can no longer be resized so narrow that its buttons are cut off
  • The hard-edged shadow that appeared around the deck after a menu or a note window had covered it is gone
  • Settings opens on General, and the deck's own menus can reach it; both font pickers now show each face in its own handwriting
